experiment: BASE-001 (modern 3D backbone under the protocol of notebook 04)
code: point-transformer-v3==0.1.2 (Pointcept), torch 2.11.0+cu130, Tesla T4 (sm_75: torch fallbacks for sparse conv and attention, padded SDPA)

training: 40 epochs x 300 steps, batch 8, AdamW lr 0.002 (blocks 0.1x), wd 0.05, warm-up 5 % + cosine, CE label smoothing 0.2, fp16 + GradScaler, clip 10, seed 0
